# NHS-OA vision {.unnumbered}

As a community, our overarching aim is to promote the use of open code and 
analytics in health and care.

## Training

The NHS-OA Community has developed/is developing training, with many of the workshops being made available on the NHS-OA Community YouTube channel and course material available on its [GitHub](https://github.com/nhs-r-community). 

## Development 

The NHS-OA Community comprises members with a very wide diversity of job roles and skills. 
Although there is no one route to being a skilled and useful analyst/data scientist/R or python developer in health and social care, nonetheless the NHS-OA Community could usefully contribute to supporting recruitment, training and development of those who use R and other open code approaches to data science and analysis.
